description: This file defines the routing endpoints for the 'notes' resource in an Express.js application, including CRUD operations and search functionality, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of notes.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to search notes by a query string.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a specific note by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new note.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing note by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a note by ID.
